steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A food allergy is an immune system reaction to a specific food protein; symptoms can be severe and include anaphylaxis (a life-threatening reaction). | Key Fact: A food intolerance is a non-immune adverse reaction to food; symptoms are usually less severe and include bloating, diarrhoea, and stomach cramps. | Key Fact: Coeliac disease is an autoimmune condition where gluten damages the small intestine lining, preventing nutrient absorption. Sufferers must follow a strict gluten-free diet. | Key Fact: Lactose intolerance is the inability to digest lactose (milk sugar) due to a lack of the enzyme lactase; symptoms include bloating and diarrhoea after consuming dairy.
